audit_title: External Data Provenance and Overlap Reconciliation

methodological_audit_findings.scientific_assessment: AUDIT DISCOVERY: While exact MD5 leakage was strictly 0 between V3 Test and V3 Train/Val, the windowed near-duplicate clustering (window=300) in V3 preparation allowed 5 perceptual near-duplicate pairs (Hamming distance <= 2) to cross between Train V3 and Test V3. Furthermore, the historical 200 Clemson evaluation sample contained 36 exact MD5 training images in V1 and 37 in V2, disproving historical claims of external independence.
